_comment: Feature 56 Frond extensibility scope contract, governed by ADR-0052.
Class calls are process-global; instance calls are instance-local.
The same four pure in-memory cases run in all four frameworks without mocks.

invariants.rule: A class registration is inherited by every Frond instance constructed afterward.
invariants.why: Applications need one explicit startup-level mechanism for process-wide Frond extensions.

invariants.rule: An instance filter registration affects that Frond instance only.
invariants.why: An instance call must not contaminate later renderers or tests.
cases: instance filter registration is instance local

invariants.rule: An instance global registration affects that Frond instance only.
invariants.why: Per-renderer values must not become process-global state.
cases: instance global registration is instance local

invariants.rule: An instance test registration affects that Frond instance only.
invariants.why: Custom predicates must obey the same scope rule as filters and globals.
cases: instance test registration is instance local
